text: --> Applying - Business Administration and Engineering Master - HTW Berlin --> Applying --> Zum Hauptinhalt / Skip to main content Master Business Administration and Engineering --> Menu --> Applying Applications for the October 2026 intake are now open. Application deadline: May 31, 2026 - We still have a few spots left! Missed the deadline? Don't worry - there's still a chance! If seats are available, we're happy to consider late applications. Do not hesitate to apply to our program - this could be your opportunity to join us! First academic degree It is important that you have accumulated a minimum of 180 credit points in your first degree programme. Ideally, your degree (Bachelor or equivalent) should be in a relevant business administration or engineering subject. However, applications from other subjects will also be considered. At least one year of professional experience after acquiring your Bachelor’s degree is also expected. English language skills A good knowledge of written and spoken English is essential. All other applicants must submit proof of their proficiency in English, as listed below. TOEFL (Institutional TOEFL is not accepted): paper-based: 580 points; computer-based: 237 points; internet-based: 94 points IELTS grade 7.0 Duolingo English Test (from level C1 - 130+ points). CPE (Certificate of Proficiency in English), all levels CAE (Certificate in Advanced English), all levels BEC Higher (Business English Certificate) All tests confirming that the level of proficiency in English complies with the level C 1 or C 2 of the Common European Framework of Reference. Previous degree and/or at least two years of work experience in a country where English is the first language (for example: Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ireland, the UK or the US) Important note: (1) Proof of English as Language of instruction from countries where English is not the first language, and/or (2) the Institutional/General TOEFL, IELTS, FCE, BEC Preliminary and BEC Vantage will not be accepted. Applicants with nearly adequate competency (e.g., TOEFL 90+ / IELTS 6.5/ Duolingo English Test 120+) with strong academic and/or professional background will be evaluated in case there is available capacity. Selection criteria: Academic background and previous studies Nature and scope of work experience (Global Leadership in Engineering: leadership and international experience) Personal motivation to study as indicated by your application documents and, if necessary, a telephone interview Application documents & Application form Please attach all required documents (in Pdf format) to the online application form. You will need the following files for the application: A copy of your degree certificate (passing certificates will not be accepted) together with a grade transcript and, if necessary, a translation in either English or German if the original is issued in another language. Applicants from India, China, Vietnam and Mongolia: Please add the certificate from the academic test centre (APS; akademische Prüfstelle) to the degree and transcript Pdf document. Further information can be found on the website of the Germany embassy or the DAAD in your country. Grading system of your university Proof of your English proficiency A letter of reference or another proof for each period of work experience listed Letter of motivation (1-2 pages): How would the MBA&E take you forward with your career plans? Alternatively to the letter of motivation, you may submit a motivation video of max. 2 minutes. Please send either an MP4 file or an online link with your application form. Your CV A scan of your passport biography page (or identity card for EU applicants) Note: Please do not send multiple applications and don't use capital letters for the texts. MBA&E Diversity Enhancement Grant “We want to empower more women for our engineering-focused MBA in Berlin” For the October 2026 intake (new students), the MBA&E will award two Diversity Enhancement Grants. This grant, which is given as a tuition fee reduction of up to 50%. Grants must be applied for within the online application, there is no separate grant application. The MBA grant committee will review the scholarship application once the admission decision has been made. Eligibility Criteria · Citizenships: Open to applicants - especially women who are citizens of underrepresented regions and demographic groups in MBAE Program. · Language Proficiency: German is not required, but a certain level is highly valued for social integration. · Ambition: A strong drive to commit and contribute to society and MBAE Program, and foster cross-cultural relations. Document requirements: 1. Submit a video in well format, clear image and voice: o Presenting what excites you the most about living and studying in Germany. o Presenting professional achievements and leadership experience regionally or internationally (especially relating to Germany). 2. List of extracurricular and volunteer activities outlining with evidences. Visa for Germany As an international student, you need a visa and proof of sufficient funds. The visa process can take several months, so we recommend applying for a visa in good time. You can usually make an appointment to apply for a visa before you receive your admission letter. But you will definitely need your admission letter at the appointment. Learn about the specific documents required for your visa application, the required level of financial proof, and the available funding options for your studies in Germany.→ Please find more information about Student Visa Germany and Blocked Account in our FAQ section. Scholarships, Funding & Loans The German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) administers the scholarship programme “ Hilde Domin Programme ” with funds from the Federal Foreign Office (AA). The programme serves to support students and doctoral candidates from across the globe, who are at risk of being formally or de facto denied educational or other rights in their country of origin, and to provide these students and doctoral candidates with an opportunity to begin or complete a study or research degree at a higher education institution in Germany. For further information regarding scholarships, please browse the DAAD Scholarship Database . Please also have a look at the general HTW Scholarships Info Website. As an MBA&E student at HTW Berlin, you will be eligible for a student loan from Studentische Darlehnskasse e.V. Berlin, or daka Berlin for short. This non-profit organisation offers student loans regardless of age, BAföG entitlement, income, nationality and semesters of study. The requirements for a loan are Enrolment at a member university (true from 1 October 2024) 1 to 2 guarantors: 18–60 years of age, permanent residence in Germany, permanent employment in Germany, net income of at least 1,450 euros/month Job opportunities as an international student in Germany Although the MBA&E is a full-time study programme, many of our students hold part-time jobs. As an international student, you are allowed to work up to 140 full days or 280 half days per year, or an unlimited number of days as an academic assistant. Students from the European Union, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, and Switzerland have unrestricted access to the German labour market. After successfully completing your studies, you may be eligible for various work visas in Germany. Additionally, our MBA&E iCareer Academy offers a wide range of application training sessions and seminars on the German job market to support your career development. Contact us Privacy policy: Our MBA&E email uses a ticket system. The information you send will be stored for six months after the last interaction using the given ticket number. No information will be conveyed to third parties. The EU general data protection regulation applies. The details are available at: LINK Refund policy If you cancel your study place before the semester starts (1 October) or within the first four weeks of the semester , you will be refunded half the fees as stipulated in the Master-Gebührenordnung of HTW Berlin. title: FAQ - Business Administration and Engineering Master - HTW Berlin
text: --> FAQ - Business Administration and Engineering Master - HTW Berlin --> FAQ --> Zum Hauptinhalt / Skip to main content Master Business Administration and Engineering --> Menu --> FAQ What is the MBA&E at HTW Berlin? The Master of Business Administration and Engineering (MBA&E) at HTW Berlin is a three-semester, English-taught program that combines management and engineering skills. It is designed for graduates with a first academic degree and at least one year of professional experience who aim to pursue leadership roles at the interface of technology and management. The program starts each winter semester at the Wilhelminenhof campus in Berlin and has a total tuition fee of €13,000. What does HTW Berlin stand for? The Berlin University of Applied Sciences (HTW Berlin) is Berlin's largest public university of applied sciences, offering practical courses in the fields of technology, computer science, economics, culture, design, law, and healthcare. It was formed in 1994 from the merger of two former universities and now offers around 80 bachelor's and master's degree programs. HTW Berlin is known for its research focus on renewable energies and digital technologies and is considered by students to be one of the most popular universities in Berlin. The programmes are extremely practice-oriented, and the university maintains strong ties with the local industry. The HTW is a public university and offers fee-based postgraduate international programmess such as the MBA&E. Am I eligible to apply? Please review the admission requirements in the “ Required Qualifications ” section. In addition, you must meet the requirements regarding professional work experience and English language proficiency . You may also send your degree certificate and transcript of records to the MBA&E Office at mbae@htw-berlin.de for a preliminary eligibility assessment. Do I need an APS certificate? If you are applying from China, India, or Vietnam, you are required to provide an APS certificate as part of your application. This certificate verifies the authenticity of your academic documents. To avoid delays in the admission process, please ensure that your APS certificate (or the confirmation of APS registration, if you are still waiting for the final certificate) is included with your application. Do I need a GMAT or GRE test to apply for the MBA&E program? No, a GMAT or GRE test is not required. The specific eligibility criteria for the MBA&E program can be found in the Eligibility and Admission Regulations and in the section Applying for the degree programme. How can I check if my first degree will be recognized for my application? If you’re unsure whether your first degree will be recognized, you can send a copy of your degree certificate and transcript to mbae@htw-berlin.de . Please include a German or English translation if necessary. When can I submit my application? 1 November to 28 February. There is no intake for the summer.oses o Late applications may be considered if seats remain available. Do I have to apply to MBA&E through an agency, third partner, or Uni-Assist? No. You can apply directly and easily to MBA&E via our official online application link . Do I have to pay any application fee? No. The application is completely free. Should I send multiple applications to apply for different specialisation options? No. Please choose your specialisation option carefully and send one application only. Redundant applications will not be considered. Do you hold application interviews? In certain cases, online interviews are conducted. You will be given plenty of notice in advance. I applied last year but did did not gain admission/did not join the programme. Do I need to send another application this year? Yes. Please submit an updated application for this year. If you received an admission (study contract) in the previous year, please include it as part of your new application. When will letters of acceptance be sent? Your application will be reviewed as soon as we receive it. Once the admission board has made a decision, our program office will contact you with the result. On average, the process takes about one month for a complete application. How much does the MBA&E program cost? €13,000 (for the winter semester 2025/26). In addition to the tuition fee, there is a semester fee, which covers your enrollment at all universities in Berlin. This fee also includes the cost of a semester ticket for public transportation in Berlin. You can find more details about the semester fee here .The "pro-forma financial plan" section of the website also provides a plan for your studies. Can I complete an internship within the program? Yes, you can undertake an optional internship during your third semester, with your Master’s thesis to be completed in the fourth semester. There is no increase in the tuition fee for this, but you will need to pay the semester (enrollment) fee for the additional semester. We especially recommend an internship at a German company for international students who are interested in working in Germany after graduation. Are there scholarships for the MBA&E programme? In the 2026 intake (new students), it is possible to apply for the MBA&E Diversity Enhancement Grant . The purpose of this grant is to encourage applications from underrepresented nationalities and female applicants in order to improve diversity among the MBA&E student body. The grant prefers applicants with outstanding extracurricular achievements, voluntary activities and prior interest and connections with Germany. The grant entails a reduction of the tuition fee of up to 50%. The applications will be evaluated after the 28th of February. Scholarship - Hilde Domin Programme The German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) administers the scholarship programme “ Hilde Domin Programme ” with funds from the Federal Foreign Office (AA). The programme serves to support students and doctoral candidates from across the globe, who are at risk of being formally or de facto denied educational or other rights in their country of origin, and to provide these students and doctoral candidates with an opportunity to begin or complete a study or research degree at a higher education institution in Germany. If you find yourself in the situation described above, please contact our Programme Office. You may also send your degree certificate and transcript of records to the MBA&E Office at mbae@htw-berlin.de for a preliminary eligibility assessment. Do I need an APS certificate? To avoid delays in the admission process, please ensure that your APS certificate (or the confirmation of APS registration, if you are still waiting for the final certificate) is included with your application. Do I need a GMAT or GRE test to apply for the MBA&E program? No, a GMAT or GRE test is not required. The specific eligibility criteria for the MBA&E program can be found in the Eligibility and Admission Regulations and in the section Applying for the degree programme. Expertise in IT security : in a globally networked world, we are heavily reliant on digital technologies. Cyber criminals are constantly developing new methods to infiltrate networks, steal data or disrupt systems. The CSB study programme will enable you to understand these threats, carry out forensic analyses, preserve evidence and develop effective protective measures. Economic expertise : when implementing cyber security measures, companies must carefully weigh up the costs and benefits. The CSB degree programme teaches you the economic methods you need to make effective decisions. Legal expertise : many industries and organisations must meet certain security and data protection standards in order to comply with legal requirements. With the CSB degree programme, you will be able to understand these standards and implement them in a legally compliant manner. The CSB degree programme offers you the basis for a career in this fast-growing field. Why study at HTW Berlin? All courses are taught in English, many modules address global cybersecurity challenges, and the programme includes a mobility semester for studying abroad. Practical orientation : all teaching staff have wide-ranging practical experience. For applying, please fill out the Pro ITD application form and submit all required documents which are mentioned in the Required documents section on this page. However, we request you to check our FAQs page where you will find answers to most of your questions related to the Pro ITD Programme. We are happy to help you with your applications! *Pro ITD programme always starts in winter semester. Required qualifications The Master of Science in "Professional IT Business and Digitalization" is a postgraduate degree programme. For admission to the Professional IT Business and Digitalization study programme you require: a Bachelor’s degree with 210 ETCS, at least 180 ETCS at least one year of professional experience after your Bachelor’s degree Good knowledge of English If less than 210 credit points (but at least 180) or less work experience, other study-relevant previous achievements may be recognised or admission requirements imposed. Application process Fill out the application form of the Master's study programme Professional IT Business and Digitalization and submit all of the following required documents. Required documents (Only PDF files) For applying you need following: Passport/Identity card Degree certificate Transcript of records and an explanation of the grading system Proof of work experience Proof of English proficiency CV Submit the listed documents along with your application. Please note, if your documents are in another language, provide an English or German translation as well. More detailed information: Passport/Identity card Provide a copy of your passport or identity card. Degree certificate Provide a copy of your degree certificate in either English or German. Applicants from China, Vietnam or Mongolia please submit a certificate from the academic test center (APS). Further information can be found on the website of the German embassy in your country. Please note that since 2022 for applicants from India, an APS certificate will be mandatory part of the documents submitted with the visa application. For more detailed information, please consult www.aps-india.de . Transcript of records and an explanation of the grading system Provide a copy of your transcript of records in either English or German. Provide an explanation of the grading system at your previous university (if it is not explained on your transcript). Proof of work experience Provide evidence of at least one year of professional experience after the first university degree. We accept official confirmation letters from employers detailing the period of employment. If you are self-employed, you can send contracts and/or tax returns, also detailing the position and the period of employment. The information shall be provided in English or German. Proof of English proficiency Acceptable documents include: TOEFL, IELTS, PTE Academic Test, comparable test giving CEFR level, proof of study in a university-level programme conducted in English for at least one year, or graduation with a complete English-language degree. No proof needed if the official language in the country of origin is English. *However, a separate language proficiency certificate might still be necessary for the visa application process to fulfill the visa requirements. CV Provide your Curriculum vitae (English or German). Selection process Study places for the Master's Programme Professional IT Business and Digitalization are allocated based on the following selection criteria: Average grade of the first professional university degree Subject of the previous study programme (Business Informatics, Applied Computer Science, Media Informatics, Environmental Informatics) Proof of English language skills based on the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages levels You have been accepted If you are accepted to the Pro ITD programme, you will then mail us: certified official copies of the degree certificate certified official copies grade transcript signed study contract Make a copy of the original documents and take both versions (copy and original) to your university OR a notary public OR the German Embassy OR any other person/institution authorised to notarise/authenticate/certify documents. Have the copies notarised as true copies of the original. Keep the originals and send us the notarised hard copies by post, together with your signed study contract. What's next? We know you will have questions about getting your visa, finding accommodation in Berlin, organising the start of your studies at HTW Berlin. After your acceptance into the programme, we will provide you with the Pro ITD Student Handbook containing detailed information on these steps. Also, please have a look at the information in the Welcome section about the various formalities you need once you arrive in Berlin, such as registration, accommodation, or bank accounts. text: --> FAQ - Professional IT Business & Digitalization Master - HTW Berlin --> FAQ --> Zum Hauptinhalt / Skip to main content Master Professional IT Business & Digitalization --> Menu --> FAQ Programme Overview Arkkordeon --> What is the Master’s in Professional IT Business & Digitalization (Pro ITD) at HTW Berlin? What is the Master’s in Professional IT Business & Digitalization (Pro ITD) at HTW Berlin? --> The Master’s in Professional IT Business & Digitalization (Pro ITD) is an English-taught international Master’s program at HTW Berlin – University of Applied Sciences , one of the biggest public universities of applied sciences in the region. The programme equips students with advanced skills in Cloud Computing, Data Science, Cybersecurity, and IT Project Management , preparing them for leadership roles in digital transformation. Arkkordeon --> Who is this program designed for? Who is this program designed for? --> This programme is ideal for graduates and early-career professionals seeking to advance in IT strategy, consulting, or product management within an international context. While previous cohorts have included candidates from Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, and related disciplines , Pro ITD has also opened up for potential students pursuing a career transition into IT roles if they have a suitable profile. Designed to be inclusive, the curriculum empowers individuals from diverse backgrounds with the technical skills and digital mindset essential for success in the fast-evolving technology sector. Arkkordeon --> Is this program suitable for fresh graduates or experienced professionals? Is this program suitable for fresh graduates or experienced professionals? --> Applicants must have at least twelve months of relevant work experience, preferable in the field of IT or related sectors. Most of the students come with 1–5 years of professional experience, seeking to deepen their technical and business expertise. Arkkordeon --> How does this program differ from a traditional MSc or MBA? How does this program differ from a traditional MSc or MBA? --> Unlike an MBA, Pro ITD blends technical depth (AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity) with business and leadership modules (IT Governance, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Transformation) —bridging the gap between technology and management. Career & Professional Development Arkkordeon --> What career opportunities are available after graduation? What career opportunities are available after graduation? --> Graduates work in roles such as IT Project Manager, Product Owner, Cloud Consultant, Business Analyst, Data Scientist, and Cybersecurity Specialist —in industries ranging from fintech and automotive to healthcare and consulting. Arkkordeon --> Where do alumni work after graduation? Where do alumni work after graduation? --> Pro ITD alumni are employed at Deutsche Bank, SAP, Accenture, Siemens, Capgemini, and AWS , as well as at startups and tech consultancies across Europe. Arkkordeon --> Does the programme offer industry exposure and networking opportunities? Does the programme offer industry exposure and networking opportunities? --> Yes. The programme includes company excursions, guest lectures, project collaborations, and trade fair visits , helping students connect directly with Berlin’s tech and startup ecosystem. Arkkordeon --> What types of job functions does this degree prepare me for? What types of job functions does this degree prepare me for? --> Graduates are well-prepared for careers in Cloud Architecture, IT Consulting, Product & Project Management, Data Analytics, and Cybersecurity Strategy . International Students Arkkordeon --> Is this programme suitable for international students? Is this programme suitable for international students? --> Absolutely. Pro ITD attracts students from over 20 nationalities each year , offering an inclusive environment in one of Europe’s most international cities. Arkkordeon --> What kind of visa do I need to study in Germany? What kind of visa do I need to study in Germany? --> Non-EU students require a student visa (Visum zu Studienzwecken) . After graduation, you can extend your residence permit for up to 18 months to find a job in Germany and eventually receive a residence permit for a EU working visa. Arkkordeon --> Can I stay and work in Germany after graduating? Can I stay and work in Germany after graduating? --> Yes. Most of the Pro ITD alumni have been able to find a full-time position already in their final thesis semester. They can apply for an EU Blue Card visa for qualified work with a respective residence permit. Alternatively, international graduates of German public universities are eligible to stay and work in Germany for up to 18 months post-graduation under the framework of a job-seeking visa. Arkkordeon --> Can I work during my studies to finance the programme? Can I work during my studies to finance the programme? --> Yes, this is possible. The German study visa permits you to work 140 full days or 280 half days which is equal to 20 hours /week. Most of our Pro ITD students work along with their studies in student assistant positions allowing them to gain further work experience in Germany. Arkkordeon --> Is German required for the programme or employment? Is German required for the programme or employment? --> The Pro ITD programme is entirely taught in English . However, learning basic German helps with daily life and increases employability in German companies. The programme offers intensive German language courses before the start of the studies as well as prior to each semester. Arkkordeon --> Is HTW Berlin a recognised university? Is HTW Berlin a recognised university? --> Yes, HTW Berlin is a state-recognised public university accredited by German authorities. Degrees awarded are internationally recognised and valued globally. In addition, HTW Berlin has a respected reputation amongst employers in the region. (link to this website: https://www.htw-berlin.de/hochschule/hochschulprofil/rankings/ ) Arkkordeon --> What is the difference between a Hochschule and a Universität? What is the difference between a Hochschule and a Universität? --> A Hochschule für Angewandte Wissenschaften such as HTW Berlin focuses on applied sciences and real-world skills , making graduates highly employable. The degree holds the same academic value as one from a traditional Universität. Admissions, Fees & Logistics Arkkordeon --> How much does the programme cost? How much does the programme cost? --> The Master’s Programme Professional IT Business and Digitalization is a fee-based international programme. Total tuition fees amount to €15,750 for three semesters , payable in three monthly installments of €5,250 each : the first during admission/enrollment, with subsequent payments before each new semester. For applicants from India: To avoid visa delays, tuition for both the first and second semesters must be fully paid or demonstrated (e.g., blocked account) before arrival. Additionally, a semester contribution fee is required each semester. For latest details and deadlines, see the university semester fee page. Arkkordeon --> Why is this programme affordable compared to US or UK programmes? Why is this programme affordable compared to US or UK programmes? --> While this is a paid programme, total costs—including tuition and semester fees—are typically lower than equivalent master’s degrees in the US or UK. German universities often offer competitive pricing due to public support for higher education, enabling quality instruction and facilities at manageable rates for international students. For payment options and financing advice, contact the admission team . Arkkordeon --> Are scholarships or funding options available? Are scholarships or funding options available? --> Yes, international students can apply for DAAD scholarships or country-specific funding . HTW Berlin also assists with scholarship guidance. Another way to finance the studies is to work as a working student. Arkkordeon --> What are the admission requirements? What are the admission requirements? --> Applicants need: A Bachelor’s degree (minimum 210 ECTS, 180 ECTS are also possible in certain cases) in relevant field such as IT, Computer Science, Engineering or Business Applications from other Academic backgrounds are eligible if the overall profile suit the programme English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL accepted): Level C1, or at least B2. Relevant work experience of at least twelve months Arkkordeon --> Do I need a GMAT or GRE score? Do I need a GMAT or GRE score? --> No. GMAT or GRE scores are not required for admission to Pro ITD. Arkkordeon --> Can I apply without a background in IT? Can I apply without a background in IT? --> Candidates with strong business or engineering backgrounds may apply, provided they demonstrate basic programming or IT systems knowledge or have gained relevant previous work experience Arkkordeon --> When is the application deadline? When is the application deadline? --> Applications for Intake 2026 open in November 2025 and close on 28 th February 2026 (for most international applicants). Arkkordeon --> Do I need to apply with Uni-Assist? Are there any costs for the application? Do I need to apply with Uni-Assist? Are there any costs for the application? --> No, we don’t use Uni-Assist. Please, submit your application directly on the application form on our website . There are no fees charged for the application. Arkkordeon --> How many seats are available per batch? How many seats are available per batch? --> Each cohort admits around 22-25 students , maintaining an ideal student–faculty ratio for personalised mentorship. Why Berlin? Arkkordeon --> Why should I study in Berlin? Why should I study in Berlin? --> Berlin is Europe’s tech innovation capital , home to 2,000+ startups, global companies, and research institutes. It offers a vibrant cultural scene, affordable living, and unmatched networking opportunities. Arkkordeon --> How does studying at HTW Berlin benefit my career? How does studying at HTW Berlin benefit my career? --> Located in Berlin’s tech hub of Oberschöneweide , HTW Berlin connects students directly with industry partners, research projects, and alumni across Europe —helping you transition smoothly into the job market. HTW Berlin holds strong accreditation within Germany for being one of the largest public universities of applied Sciences, consistently ranked high for its strong industry connections and for maintaining a large alumni network employed at leading companies in the region. Student Life & Support Arkkordeon --> What support services are available for students? What support services are available for students? --> HTW Berlin offers academic advising, free German language courses, psychological counselling, sports facilities, and career support . The Pro ITD team also assists with onboarding, accommodation guidance, and integration in Berlin. Arkkordeon --> Are there success stories from alumni? Are there success stories from alumni? --> Yes—many graduates now work as Tech Leads, Business Analysts, and Product Managers across Europe. Their career journeys are regularly featured on our LinkedIn page. nach oben Themen Popular pages Portals Counselling & advice Service

You would need 11,904 € (please double check with your local embassy the correct amount since it can vary depending on your home country) for this account in order to be granted the visa. Other documents such as passport and study confirmation will also be necessary. Tuition can be paid in three instalments, one per semester, during enrolment and re-registration. One instalment equals 5,250€. Living costs In addition to the study related fees, students need approximately 900-1,200€ per month to cover living expenses. Professionals with management, economic skills and work experience who want to obtain additional in-depth knowledge in IT and computer science. Tech heart of Berlin Studying and working at the Berlin tech scene, also known as a capital of start ups, gives you unique experience and opportunities to meet like-minded people and grow your professional network. What is the Master’s in Professional IT Business & Digitalization (Pro ITD) at HTW Berlin? --> The Master’s in Professional IT Business & Digitalization (Pro ITD) is an English-taught international Master’s program at HTW Berlin – University of Applied Sciences , one of the biggest public universities of applied sciences in the region. The programme equips students with advanced skills in Cloud Computing, Data Science, Cybersecurity, and IT Project Management , preparing them for leadership roles in digital transformation. Arkkordeon --> Who is this program designed for? Who is this program designed for? --> This programme is ideal for graduates and early-career professionals seeking to advance in IT strategy, consulting, or product management within an international context. While previous cohorts have included candidates from Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, and related disciplines , Pro ITD has also opened up for potential students pursuing a career transition into IT roles if they have a suitable profile. Designed to be inclusive, the curriculum empowers individuals from diverse backgrounds with the technical skills and digital mindset essential for success in the fast-evolving technology sector. Arkkordeon --> Is this program suitable for fresh graduates or experienced professionals? Is this program suitable for fresh graduates or experienced professionals? --> Applicants must have at least twelve months of relevant work experience, preferable in the field of IT or related sectors. Most of the students come with 1–5 years of professional experience, seeking to deepen their technical and business expertise. Arkkordeon --> How does this program differ from a traditional MSc or MBA? How does this program differ from a traditional MSc or MBA? --> Unlike an MBA, Pro ITD blends technical depth (AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity) with business and leadership modules (IT Governance, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Transformation) —bridging the gap between technology and management. Career & Professional Development Arkkordeon --> What career opportunities are available after graduation? What career opportunities are available after graduation? --> Graduates work in roles such as IT Project Manager, Product Owner, Cloud Consultant, Business Analyst, Data Scientist, and Cybersecurity Specialist —in industries ranging from fintech and automotive to healthcare and consulting. Arkkordeon --> Where do alumni work after graduation? Where do alumni work after graduation? --> Pro ITD alumni are employed at Deutsche Bank, SAP, Accenture, Siemens, Capgemini, and AWS , as well as at startups and tech consultancies across Europe. Arkkordeon --> Does the programme offer industry exposure and networking opportunities? Does the programme offer industry exposure and networking opportunities? --> Yes. The programme includes company excursions, guest lectures, project collaborations, and trade fair visits , helping students connect directly with Berlin’s tech and startup ecosystem. Arkkordeon --> What types of job functions does this degree prepare me for? What types of job functions does this degree prepare me for? --> Graduates are well-prepared for careers in Cloud Architecture, IT Consulting, Product & Project Management, Data Analytics, and Cybersecurity Strategy . International Students Arkkordeon --> Is this programme suitable for international students? Is this programme suitable for international students? --> Absolutely. Pro ITD attracts students from over 20 nationalities each year , offering an inclusive environment in one of Europe’s most international cities. Arkkordeon --> What kind of visa do I need to study in Germany? What kind of visa do I need to study in Germany? --> Non-EU students require a student visa (Visum zu Studienzwecken) . After graduation, you can extend your residence permit for up to 18 months to find a job in Germany and eventually receive a residence permit for a EU working visa. Arkkordeon --> Can I stay and work in Germany after graduating? Can I stay and work in Germany after graduating? --> Yes. Most of the Pro ITD alumni have been able to find a full-time position already in their final thesis semester. They can apply for an EU Blue Card visa for qualified work with a respective residence permit. Alternatively, international graduates of German public universities are eligible to stay and work in Germany for up to 18 months post-graduation under the framework of a job-seeking visa. Arkkordeon --> Can I work during my studies to finance the programme? Can I work during my studies to finance the programme? --> Yes, this is possible. The German study visa permits you to work 140 full days or 280 half days which is equal to 20 hours /week. Most of our Pro ITD students work along with their studies in student assistant positions allowing them to gain further work experience in Germany. Arkkordeon --> Is German required for the programme or employment? Is German required for the programme or employment? --> The Pro ITD programme is entirely taught in English . However, learning basic German helps with daily life and increases employability in German companies. The programme offers intensive German language courses before the start of the studies as well as prior to each semester. Arkkordeon --> Is HTW Berlin a recognised university? Is HTW Berlin a recognised university? --> Yes, HTW Berlin is a state-recognised public university accredited by German authorities. Degrees awarded are internationally recognised and valued globally. In addition, HTW Berlin has a respected reputation amongst employers in the region. (link to this website: https://www.htw-berlin.de/hochschule/hochschulprofil/rankings/ ) Arkkordeon --> What is the difference between a Hochschule and a Universität? What is the difference between a Hochschule and a Universität? --> A Hochschule für Angewandte Wissenschaften such as HTW Berlin focuses on applied sciences and real-world skills , making graduates highly employable. The degree holds the same academic value as one from a traditional Universität. Admissions, Fees & Logistics Arkkordeon --> How much does the programme cost? How much does the programme cost? --> The Master’s Programme Professional IT Business and Digitalization is a fee-based international programme. Total tuition fees amount to €15,750 for three semesters , payable in three monthly installments of €5,250 each : the first during admission/enrollment, with subsequent payments before each new semester. For applicants from India: To avoid visa delays, tuition for both the first and second semesters must be fully paid or demonstrated (e.g., blocked account) before arrival. Additionally, a semester contribution fee is required each semester. For latest details and deadlines, see the university semester fee page. Arkkordeon --> Why is this programme affordable compared to US or UK programmes? Why is this programme affordable compared to US or UK programmes? --> While this is a paid programme, total costs—including tuition and semester fees—are typically lower than equivalent master’s degrees in the US or UK. German universities often offer competitive pricing due to public support for higher education, enabling quality instruction and facilities at manageable rates for international students. For payment options and financing advice, contact the admission team . Arkkordeon --> Are scholarships or funding options available? Are scholarships or funding options available? --> Yes, international students can apply for DAAD scholarships or country-specific funding . HTW Berlin also assists with scholarship guidance. Another way to finance the studies is to work as a working student. Arkkordeon --> What are the admission requirements? What are the admission requirements? --> Applicants need: A Bachelor’s degree (minimum 210 ECTS, 180 ECTS are also possible in certain cases) in relevant field such as IT, Computer Science, Engineering or Business Applications from other Academic backgrounds are eligible if the overall profile suit the programme English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL accepted): Level C1, or at least B2. Relevant work experience of at least twelve months Arkkordeon --> Do I need a GMAT or GRE score? Do I need a GMAT or GRE score? --> No. GMAT or GRE scores are not required for admission to Pro ITD. Arkkordeon --> Can I apply without a background in IT? Can I apply without a background in IT? --> Candidates with strong business or engineering backgrounds may apply, provided they demonstrate basic programming or IT systems knowledge or have gained relevant previous work experience Arkkordeon --> When is the application deadline? When is the application deadline? --> Applications for Intake 2026 open in November 2025 and close on 28 th February 2026 (for most international applicants). Arkkordeon --> Do I need to apply with Uni-Assist? Are there any costs for the application? Do I need to apply with Uni-Assist? Are there any costs for the application? --> No, we don’t use Uni-Assist. Please, submit your application directly on the application form on our website . There are no fees charged for the application. Arkkordeon --> How many seats are available per batch? How many seats are available per batch? --> Each cohort admits around 22-25 students , maintaining an ideal student–faculty ratio for personalised mentorship. Why Berlin? Arkkordeon --> Why should I study in Berlin? Why should I study in Berlin? --> Berlin is Europe’s tech innovation capital , home to 2,000+ startups, global companies, and research institutes. It offers a vibrant cultural scene, affordable living, and unmatched networking opportunities. Arkkordeon --> How does studying at HTW Berlin benefit my career? How does studying at HTW Berlin benefit my career? --> Located in Berlin’s tech hub of Oberschöneweide , HTW Berlin connects students directly with industry partners, research projects, and alumni across Europe —helping you transition smoothly into the job market. HTW Berlin holds strong accreditation within Germany for being one of the largest public universities of applied Sciences, consistently ranked high for its strong industry connections and for maintaining a large alumni network employed at leading companies in the region. Student Life & Support Arkkordeon --> What support services are available for students? What support services are available for students? --> HTW Berlin offers academic advising, free German language courses, psychological counselling, sports facilities, and career support . The Pro ITD team also assists with onboarding, accommodation guidance, and integration in Berlin. Arkkordeon --> Are there success stories from alumni? Are there success stories from alumni? --> Yes—many graduates now work as Tech Leads, Business Analysts, and Product Managers across Europe. Their career journeys are regularly featured on our LinkedIn page. nach oben Themen Popular pages Portals Counselling & advice Service

title: Applying - Project Management and Data Science Master - HTW Berlin
text: --> Applying - Project Management and Data Science Master - HTW Berlin --> Applying --> Zum Hauptinhalt / Skip to main content Master Project Management and Data Science --> Menu --> Applying Applications welcome for MPMD We are currently accepting applications for the International Master's in Project Management and Data Science (MPMD) for Intake summer semester 2027 (start of studies: 1 April 2027). Application period is from 1 May to 31 August 2026. To apply: Prepare the required documents (see below), then Fill out the online application form Any questions? We are happy to help: Admission-MPMD@HTW-Berlin.de We are looking forward to your application! Do I qualify? To be considered for the International Master’s in Project Management and Data Science you need: A bachelor degree with at least 180 ECTS At least 1 year of qualified professional experience after acquiring your bachelor’s degree (though not necessarily in the area of project management or data science) Proof of English language proficiency Required documents Attached to the online application form, submit the following documents: A copy of your degree certificate Applicants from China , Vietnam or India please also submit a certificate from the academic test centre (APS). The APS must state which degree certificate it refers to. Further information can be found following the links above or on the website of the German embassy in your country. A copy of your grade transcript If in another language, also provide a translation in either English or German. Provide an explanation of the grading system at your previous university (if not explained in your transcript of records). If the number of credits taken does not appear on your transcript, also send evidence of the number of credits from the first higher education degree and any further completed studies. Evidence of at least one year of professional* experience in any field after the first university degree Provide official confirmation letter/s of employer/s detailing the period of time worked there. If you are self-employed, you may send contracts and/or tax statements. Proof of English proficiency Acceptable documents include: TOEFL, IELTS, PTE Academic Test, comparable test giving CEFR level, proof of study in a university-level programme conducted in English for at least one year, or graduation with a complete English-language degree. (No proof needed if the official language in the country of origin is English.) A copy of your passport or identity card Curriculum vitae (résumé) Please also include: Letter of reference : academic and/or work-related Link to video of motivation or letter of motivation *A position at a level that reflects your previous academic degree, such as project manager, architect, etc., as opposed to janitor, intern and so on How will my application be ranked? Study places are allocated according to the following selection criteria: Final grade of the first university-level degree (50%) Number of years of professional experience after the first university degree (more than one year/more than two years) (25%) English language skills (according to CEFR: level B2 or lower/level C1 or higher) (25%) TOEFL: Level C1 is 95+ points for the internet based test IELTS: Level C1 is 7.0+ points PTE Academic Test: Level C1 is 76+ points Comparable tests giving CEFR level can also be used. Proof of study in a university-level programme conducted in English for at least one year, or graduation with complete English-language degree, will also be recognised as Level C1. No proof needed if the official language in the country of origin is English. Applicants providing evidence of Level B2 English language skills or lower will come next in ranking. After this selection process, MPMD makes further efforts to admit a balance of genders, nationalities, etc. to ensure a diverse cohort. Costs & financing Tuition and fees Tuition: €17,600 (paid in four installments of €4,400 per semester) Fees: approximately €350 per semester (including public transport in Berlin and all of Germany - “Deutschlandticket”) Scholarships While there are no scholarships available from HTW Berlin, you can check the DAAD website for possible scholarships . Job opportunities Although the MPMD is a full-time study programme, many of our students hold a part-time job. As an international student you are allowed to work 140 full days or 280 half days per year or an unlimited number of days as an academic assistant. Students from the European Union, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland have unrestricted access to the German labour market. After your successful completion of your studies, you are entitled to different work visas in Germany. We offer application trainings. Student loan with daka Berlin As an MPMD student at HTW Berlin, you will be eligible for a student loan from Studentische Darlehnskasse e.V. Berlin, or daka Berlin for short. This non-profit organisation offers student loans regardless of age, BAföG entitlement, income, nationality and semesters of study. The requirements for a loan are Enrolment at a member university (true from 1 October 2024) 1 to 2 guarantors: 18-60 years of age, permanent residence in Germany, permanent employment in Germany, net income of at least 1,450 euros/month Refund policy as stipulated in the Master-Gebührenordnung of HTW Berlin: If you cancel your study place before the start of your studies , you will be refunded half the tuition fee and the full semester fee minus an administrative fee of 50 Euros If you cancel your study place within the first four weeks of the semester, you will be refunded half the tuition and semester fees After that, the full fee is due and not refundable Exception: If the study programme cannot be taken up due to a rejected visa application , the programme fees and semester fees will be refunded in full, minus an administrative fee of 50,- Euros. The rejection of the visa application must must be proven. I've been accepted! Congratulations! If you are accepted to the MPMD programme, you will then mail us certified official copies of the degree certificate and grade transcript OR your APS certificate if you come from China, Vietnam or India (and have not already sent the APS), together with the study contract. For certified official copies, make a copy of the original documents and take both versions (copy and original) to your university OR a notary public OR the German Embassy OR any other person/institution authorised to notarise/authenticate/certify documents. Have the copies notarised as true copies of the original. You keep the originals and send us the notarised hard copies by post, together with your study contract. What's next? We know you’ll have questions about getting your visa, finding accomodation in Berlin, organising the start of your studies at HTW Berlin ... Upon your acceptance into the programme, we will provide you with the MPMD Student Handbook containing detailed information on these steps. And you can always email the MPMD admissions team ! We will support you throughout your application process. title: Applying - Project Management and Data Science Master - HTW Berlin
text: --> Applying - Project Management and Data Science Master - HTW Berlin --> Applying --> Zum Hauptinhalt / Skip to main content Master Project Management and Data Science --> Menu --> Applying Applications welcome for MPMD We are currently accepting applications for the International Master's in Project Management and Data Science (MPMD) for Intake summer semester 2027 (start of studies: 1 April 2027). Application period is from 1 May to 31 August 2026. To apply: Prepare the required documents (see below), then Fill out the online application form Any questions? We are happy to help: Admission-MPMD@HTW-Berlin.de We are looking forward to your application! Do I qualify? To be considered for the International Master’s in Project Management and Data Science you need: A bachelor degree with at least 180 ECTS At least 1 year of qualified professional experience after acquiring your bachelor’s degree (though not necessarily in the area of project management or data science) Proof of English language proficiency Required documents Attached to the online application form, submit the following documents: A copy of your degree certificate Applicants from China , Vietnam or India please also submit a certificate from the academic test centre (APS). The APS must state which degree certificate it refers to. Further information can be found following the links above or on the website of the German embassy in your country. A copy of your grade transcript If in another language, also provide a translation in either English or German. Provide an explanation of the grading system at your previous university (if not explained in your transcript of records). If the number of credits taken does not appear on your transcript, also send evidence of the number of credits from the first higher education degree and any further completed studies. Evidence of at least one year of professional* experience in any field after the first university degree Provide official confirmation letter/s of employer/s detailing the period of time worked there. If you are self-employed, you may send contracts and/or tax statements. Proof of English proficiency Acceptable documents include: TOEFL, IELTS, PTE Academic Test, comparable test giving CEFR level, proof of study in a university-level programme conducted in English for at least one year, or graduation with a complete English-language degree. (No proof needed if the official language in the country of origin is English.) A copy of your passport or identity card Curriculum vitae (résumé) Please also include: Letter of reference : academic and/or work-related Link to video of motivation or letter of motivation *A position at a level that reflects your previous academic degree, such as project manager, architect, etc., as opposed to janitor, intern and so on How will my application be ranked? Study places are allocated according to the following selection criteria: Final grade of the first university-level degree (50%) Number of years of professional experience after the first university degree (more than one year/more than two years) (25%) English language skills (according to CEFR: level B2 or lower/level C1 or higher) (25%) TOEFL: Level C1 is 95+ points for the internet based test IELTS: Level C1 is 7.0+ points PTE Academic Test: Level C1 is 76+ points Comparable tests giving CEFR level can also be used. Proof of study in a university-level programme conducted in English for at least one year, or graduation with complete English-language degree, will also be recognised as Level C1. No proof needed if the official language in the country of origin is English. Applicants providing evidence of Level B2 English language skills or lower will come next in ranking. After this selection process, MPMD makes further efforts to admit a balance of genders, nationalities, etc. to ensure a diverse cohort. Costs & financing Tuition and fees Tuition: €17,600 (paid in four installments of €4,400 per semester) Fees: approximately €350 per semester (including public transport in Berlin and all of Germany - “Deutschlandticket”) Scholarships While there are no scholarships available from HTW Berlin, you can check the DAAD website for possible scholarships . Job opportunities Although the MPMD is a full-time study programme, many of our students hold a part-time job. As an international student you are allowed to work 140 full days or 280 half days per year or an unlimited number of days as an academic assistant. Students from the European Union, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland have unrestricted access to the German labour market. After your successful completion of your studies, you are entitled to different work visas in Germany. We offer application trainings. Student loan with daka Berlin As an MPMD student at HTW Berlin, you will be eligible for a student loan from Studentische Darlehnskasse e.V. Berlin, or daka Berlin for short. This non-profit organisation offers student loans regardless of age, BAföG entitlement, income, nationality and semesters of study. The requirements for a loan are Enrolment at a member university (true from 1 October 2024) 1 to 2 guarantors: 18-60 years of age, permanent residence in Germany, permanent employment in Germany, net income of at least 1,450 euros/month Refund policy as stipulated in the Master-Gebührenordnung of HTW Berlin: If you cancel your study place before the start of your studies , you will be refunded half the tuition fee and the full semester fee minus an administrative fee of 50 Euros If you cancel your study place within the first four weeks of the semester, you will be refunded half the tuition and semester fees After that, the full fee is due and not refundable Exception: If the study programme cannot be taken up due to a rejected visa application , the programme fees and semester fees will be refunded in full, minus an administrative fee of 50,- Euros. The rejection of the visa application must must be proven. I've been accepted! Congratulations! If you are accepted to the MPMD programme, you will then mail us certified official copies of the degree certificate and grade transcript OR your APS certificate if you come from China, Vietnam or India (and have not already sent the APS), together with the study contract. For certified official copies, make a copy of the original documents and take both versions (copy and original) to your university OR a notary public OR the German Embassy OR any other person/institution authorised to notarise/authenticate/certify documents. Have the copies notarised as true copies of the original. You keep the originals and send us the notarised hard copies by post, together with your study contract. What's next? We know you’ll have questions about getting your visa, finding accomodation in Berlin, organising the start of your studies at HTW Berlin ... Upon your acceptance into the programme, we will provide you with the MPMD Student Handbook containing detailed information on these steps. And you can always email the MPMD admissions team ! We will support you throughout your application process.
